blocking_focus: Complete the candidate-bound Tester MCP state matrix.

Keep frozen technical baseline `host_godot_boot` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

task_specification.objective: Advance release convergence through three independent repairs: restore automatic combat audio causality, make dense-run qualification deterministic and renderer-honest, and close the complete-run lifecycle with authored upgrade-choice presentation and spatially coherent arena traversal.

diagnosis.root_cause: Automatic lantern attacks resolve but lack a bound audible semantic onset source, while dense-run evidence is rejected under llvmpipe and cannot qualify native performance. The complete-run contract still needs direct success/failure, upgrade-commit, Result, Retry, authored choice presentation, and spatial traversal proof.

stop_conditions: Preserve native_godot_project, host_godot_boot, and the intact authored cemetery package.
Do not fabricate native performance evidence under a software renderer.
Do not replace retained source recordings or perform destructive authored-asset surgery.
Do not schedule backlog-only gaps or exceed the three host-selected task families.

strategy.rationale: Use explicit semantic event binding and bounded audio ownership for the repeatedly treated audio issue instead of transform tuning. Separately strengthen deterministic dense profiling with renderer preflight, then repair authoritative run lifecycle, choice presentation, and authored-world spatial contracts in the ordinary release family.

code: Run Godot parser/import/boot checks and focused tests for semantic audio deduplication, AUTO release/reset, dense profile receipt schema, upgrade commit, and authoritative Retry reset.
Verify tester_* actions are release-guarded and touched scenes/scripts introduce no runtime errors.
runtime: Capture Effects and Master for one SEMI and one quick AUTO tap, isolating onset, impact, miss, metal, and character-hit stems with source-event timelines.
Run tester_dense_prepare, tester_dense_advance, and three reset cycles; record renderer/backend, frame-time distribution, subsystem counts, sample availability, and qualification status.
Exercise ordinary start→combat→upgrade→success→Result→Retry and failure→Result→Retry; verify upgrade commit precedes resumed play and diagnostic routes cannot fill build-shape cells.
visual: Inspect upgrade cards at native viewport, fullscreen/windowed, and supported UI scales for silhouettes, compact icons, truthful current-to-new values, no more than three deltas, and keyboard/mouse/gamepad focus states.

Capture spawn, critical route, central building/landmark, and boundary/perimeter gameplay views during ordinary movement; verify expand/larger traversable scale, external world/external depth, collision alignment, and no disappearance or occlusion drift.
Inspect Result and post-Retry HUD for complete summary, clean overlays, readable arena composition, and preserved authored cemetery presentation.

done_when: Each accepted Warden Lantern attack emits exactly one recognizable bounded onset transient and one legal-hit impact on Effects; one SEMI click and one quick AUTO tap are independently visible in source-event and mixed-output evidence.
Cadence-valid AUTO continuation stops on release and lifecycle reset; receipts include weapon id, owner, phase, generation, and deduplication key, with no generic shot-VFX replay.
The retained component FireAudio/AutoFireAudio source and coupled viewmodel hierarchy remain unchanged; Tester has direct same-session black-box and white-box retests.
tasks.instructions: Repair the product-owned lantern audio boundary by binding an explicit semantic onset event to the actual Warden Lantern emission path. Route a short bounded onset separately from miss, concrete hit, metal hit, character-hit, and impact stems. Preserve the retained component gun audio and coupled viewmodel profile. Ensure one attack authorization maps to one onset and one impact, and clear pending voices and dedupe state on release, pause/reset, and lifecycle restart.
tasks.title: Restore automatic combat audio causality

done_when: tester_dense_prepare ends in a stable inspectable state without advancing or capturing; tester_dense_advance records requested, resolved, reset_isolation, setup_generation, advance_generation, and three-cycle identities.

The profile reports frame_ms/FPS, physics/render samples, active enemies/projectiles/pickups/effects/lights/audio voices, allocation/orphan/runtime-error counts, renderer classification, and hardware eligibility at 25–40 enemy density.

Native qualification is emitted only for the required native renderer and three complete reset cycles; llvmpipe/software sessions remain explicitly rejected or pending with measurements retained. Release exports keep tester paths unavailable and ordinary balance unchanged.
tasks.instructions: Strengthen the deterministic dense profile's preparation, advance, and reset lifecycle. Classify renderer before the final qualification gate while retaining frame and subsystem measurements. Guard all tester_* actions from release builds and reset pooled entities, timers, signals, and pending work before each cycle. Surface truthful software-renderer status instead of fabricating native qualification.
tasks.title: Make dense-run qualification reproducible

done_when: An ordinary successful route commits an upgrade before play resumes, reaches Result with truthful victory and build summaries, and Retry returns to a playable start with a new authoritative run generation and no stale enemies, drops, upgrades, audio, or HUD overlays.

A failure route reaches Result and Retry cleanly but cannot qualify a successful build shape; ordinary route evidence distinguishes focused bolts, close-range sweeps, and orbiting area-control outcomes where applicable.

Upgrade choices use an authored visual hierarchy: recognizable silhouettes/icons lead, compact stat icons show no more than three truthful current-to-new deltas, unchanged or exhaustive rows are omitted, CURRENT never shows NEW or LOCKED placeholders, and keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus/hover/selected states are complete.

The arena uses expand or larger traversable scale with coherent external world or external depth; the central building or landmark remains visible and has aligned collision; ordinary movement or movement replay cannot cause disappearance or occlusion drift; collision remains aligned at the boundary or perimeter.
tasks.instructions: Close the authoritative run-controller, ledger, upgrade-draft, Result, and Retry transaction end to end. Preserve the authored cemetery package as the sole visual environment while repairing spawn/objective anchors, collision, navigation, and perimeter framing around native streets. Integrate the required choice visual hierarchy without default/debug styling. Any tester_* preparation must remain stable and separate from advance/commit, include setup generation and release-build guards, and never qualify diagnostic rows as ordinary builds. Verify expand or larger traversable scale, external world or external depth, central building or landmark visibility, collision, disappearance or occlusion safety, boundary or perimeter alignment, and ordinary movement or movement replay.
tasks.title: Close complete-run, Retry, and spatial presentation
